gen_text: The weather is clear today, and the city sounds calm.
Some call me nature, others call me mother nature. I do not really care what you call me, but I have been here far longer than any of us can remember.

I have watched species evolve, empires rise and fall, and generations come and go. Through storms, droughts, and quiet mornings, I remain patient. If you listen closely, you will hear that every forest, river, and mountain is telling the same story about time, change, and endurance.
